# Deep scans of the whole AH and the per item records they must produce (ForeverMarket scan/Snapshot.lua
# FM.FinalizeSnapshot, record format in its header and in addons/ForeverMarket/README.md).
# Shared by tests/forevermarket/snapshot_test.lua and tests/feed/test_feed.py: the feed's Python port
# (build_records with record_hours 0 and compact records, like a deep scan in the game) must write
# byte for byte the same records. Every seller is unknown, as in Forever's full scan and the Battle.net API.
#
# field <name> <position>               a record field by name (base36 numbers, field 1 is "r<minutes>")
# scenario <name> <start>               a sequence of scans; start = minutes since FM.EPOCH (2026-01-01 UTC)
# snapshot <minutes>                    a deep scan this many minutes after the start
# auction <item> <count> <buyout> <band>  an auction of that scan (buyout = total copper, band = time left 0-3)
# record <item> <name>=<value> ...      the record the scan must write for the item, values in decimal;
#                                       fields not named are empty, trailing empty fields are left out
# unchanged <item> <gap minutes>        the scan must write the compact "unchanged" record "r<minutes>,=,<gap>"
# Every scan must write records for exactly the items listed under it.

field min 2
field qty 3
field auctions 4
field q5 5
field q20 6
field median 7
field own 8
field gap 9
field sold 10
field soldN 11
field soldVal 12
field amb 13
field rep 14
field new 15
field newMin 16
field ladder 17
field sales 18
field newLadder 19
field ownMin 20
field minOther 21
field soldLow 22

scenario linen-day 432000

# First scan: nothing to compare with, market state only.
# 2589: units 100 (20), 104 (10), 118 (5), 150 (1); within +5% of 100: 30, within +20%: 35;
# the median unit (by quantity, 36 / 2 = 18) is 100
snapshot 0
auction 2589 20 2000 3
auction 2589 10 1040 3
auction 2589 5 590 2
auction 2589 1 150 1
auction 4306 1 2500 0
record 2589 min=100 qty=36 auctions=4 q5=30 q20=35 median=100
record 4306 min=2500 qty=1 auctions=1 q5=1 q20=1 median=2500

# An hour later.
# 2589: 8 bought off the 20 stack (now 12 at the same unit price, the cheapest buy); the long 5 at 118
# gone (cannot expire in an hour: sold, but the 104 auction stayed, so not a cheapest buy); the medium 1
# at 150 gone (may have expired: ambiguous); 4 new at 95
# 4306: its only (short) auction is gone: a record of an empty market, ambiguous
# 2592: listed for the first time: all of it is new
snapshot 60
auction 2589 12 1200 3
auction 2589 10 1040 3
auction 2589 4 380 3
auction 2592 20 4000 3
record 2589 min=95 qty=26 auctions=3 q5=4 q20=26 median=100 gap=60 sold=13 soldN=2 soldVal=1390 amb=1 new=4 newMin=95 soldLow=8
record 4306 qty=0 auctions=0 gap=60 amb=1 soldLow=0
record 2592 min=200 qty=20 auctions=1 q5=20 q20=20 median=200 gap=60 new=20 newMin=200 soldLow=0

# 2589 did not change: the compact record. 2592 undercut by a seller we cannot see: the same quantity
# again at 90% of the old unit price = a repost (the new auction still counts as new).
# 4306 was already gone: no record.
snapshot 120
auction 2589 12 1200 3
auction 2589 10 1040 3
auction 2589 4 380 3
auction 2592 20 3600 3
unchanged 2589 60
record 2592 min=180 qty=20 auctions=1 q5=20 q20=20 median=180 gap=60 rep=20 new=20 newMin=180 soldLow=0

# 49 hours later: scans more than 48 hours apart are not compared, market state only
snapshot 3060
auction 2589 12 1200 3
auction 2589 10 1040 3
auction 2589 4 380 3
auction 2592 20 3600 3
record 2589 min=95 qty=26 auctions=3 q5=4 q20=26 median=100
record 2592 min=180 qty=20 auctions=1 q5=20 q20=20 median=180

# Nothing changed since the scan before: compact records against that one
snapshot 3120
auction 2589 12 1200 3
auction 2589 10 1040 3
auction 2589 4 380 3
auction 2592 20 3600 3
unchanged 2589 60
unchanged 2592 60
